data.description:
## Reproduction

1. Story has all child tasks closed but completion-verifier returns `P1: FAIL` on a story DD.
2. Phase F Step 18 of `/dso:sprint` directs the orchestrator to "re-invoke /dso:implementation-plan to create TDD remediation tasks".
3. The implementation-plan skill's `check-reinvocation.sh` returns `verdict=all_closed`.
4. Per the skill output protocol, the skill emits `STATUS:complete TASKS:<closed_ids> STORY:<story-id>` and exits early.
5. Sprint orchestrator parses `STATUS:complete` and proceeds to re-verifier (which still returns FAIL because no new tasks were created).
6. Infinite loop: verifier FAIL → impl-plan re-invoke → impl-plan early-exit → re-verifier FAIL → ...

## Expected

When the parent epic has a `REPLAN_TRIGGER: validation` comment indicating the verifier flagged the story FAIL, the implementation-plan re-invocation guard should switch to **diff-plan mode** and produce new tasks covering the uncovered DDs (using the verifier's `remediation_tasks_created` payload as the source).

## Actual

The guard exits early with `STATUS:complete` regardless of REPLAN_TRIGGER markers on the parent epic. No new tasks are created. The orchestrator either loops indefinitely OR (workaround used here) the user authorizes inline fixes bypassing the protocol.

## Evidence

- Encountered during epic f691-681e on 2026-05-19 for stories S3 (7462-6284-9dd3-4f2c) and S_migration (6d15-f5f6-2919-4d37) after completion-verifier returned P1:FAIL on DD2 + DD5 (S3) and DD2 (S_migration).
- Both stories had all 5 + 10 child tasks closed respectively.
- User-authorized workaround: inline edits with `DSO_SPRINT_ACTIVE=0 DSO_SPRINT_ACTIVE_BYPASS_REASON=...` to bypass the merge-only check and commit fixes directly to session worktree. See commit 97c922c11a on session-cont-20260519-131000.

## Proposed fix

1. Modify `plugins/dso/scripts/implementation-plan/check-reinvocation.sh` to ALSO inspect the parent epic's recent comments for `REPLAN_TRIGGER: validation` markers that reference the current story.
2. When such a marker exists AND verdict would otherwise be `all_closed`, return `verdict=diff_plan` instead, with a hint that the input is a verifier remediation payload.
3. Modify the implementation-plan SKILL.md to consume verifier `remediation_tasks_created` JSON when entering diff_plan mode via this REPLAN_TRIGGER path. Each entry becomes one new task with proper TDD structure.

## Scope

P1. Real protocol gap causing repeated inline-fix bypasses. Workaround exists (inline + bypass env vars) but the protocol-correct path is not currently traversable.

## Related

- Bug 535a-9d42-cb16-445c (scan-red-markers delta-mode) — same epic surfaced both issues at PR merge time.
data.title: implementation-plan re-invocation guard: all_closed verdict creates loop when completion-verifier returns P1:FAIL
